_doc: PRE-REGISTERED premarket-touch-credit study, frozen BEFORE any candidate replay. Motivated by J's Monday 2026-07-20 ~09:36 ET premarket question (queue.md PREMARKET-TOUCH-CREDIT-STUDY, HIGH): SPY rejected the 747.4-747.5 zone at the premarket open, danced around it again ~08:30, and approached it a third time near the bell -- and the engine gave that zone ZERO touch-credit because level_states touch counting starts at 09:30 RTH. This is a SEGMENTATION study, not a shape sweep: does the SAME live exit shape (SS-B, structure_stop_enabled=true, trigger-exact reference, buffer 0.00 -- today's actual live behavior, == structure-stop-zone-band-2026-07-20.json BAND-00 / structure-stop-reference-level-2026-07-20.json REF-EXACT) perform differently on RTH rejection/reclaim triggers whose trigger_level had >=1 premarket rejection/reclaim bar vs triggers at levels that were never tested premarket? KILL is a valid, expected, disclosed-in-advance outcome (small-n).
reuses: structure_stop_study.py's replay engine (replay_structure_aware, structure_stop_signal_time, SS_B_SHAPE, TIME_STOP_LAYER_A) and tw8_level_context.py's frozen_level_set_for_date/load_spy_full (the SAME per-day-frozen multi-level active set orchestrator.py itself trades against) UNCHANGED. lib.filters.detect_level_rejection/detect_level_reclaim (the exact production bar-test) reused verbatim for premarket touch detection -- zero new hand-picked band/proximity parameter introduced (the item's own zones-not-prices doctrine concern is about entry triggers, already zoned; premarket touch detection reuses the identical strict engine test the RTH trigger itself uses, direction-matched).
strategy: ribbon_ride (both directions) fresh-slice signal population only this run; a real-fills layer-b anchor is EXPLICITLY DEFERRED (see scope_note) to avoid a 3rd live-OPRA-network-fetch replay in one session on what may be an underpowered/KILL population per the cheaper layer alone.
scope_note: Layer (b) real-fills anchor (live Alpaca OPRA re-fetch, ~$4 cost per tonight's 2 prior structure-stop studies) is DEFERRED to a follow-up fire, gated on layer (a) clearing significance -- running it now on an a-priori-likely-underpowered population would repeat tonight's 3rd expensive network-fetch replay for no incremental decision value. This is a scope narrowing, not a silent omission: disclosed here, and the deferred exhibit is filed back to queue.md as a follow-up item if (and only if) layer (a) shows a non-null, sub-window-stable, non-concentrated effect.
fresh_slice_population: Combined from TWO already-cached, already-fetched (no new network calls: local option-bar cache via t4._load_bars/load_contract_bars) ribbon_ride real-fills signal sets, both within the Alpaca-SIP-verified premarket price window (DATA-PROVENANCE.md: 2026-05-19 onward = real SIP premarket OHLC): (1) analysis/exit-parity/signal-set.json (canonical 2025-01-01..2026-06-18 cache) filtered to date in [2026-05-19, 2026-07-17]; (2) analysis/exit-parity/signal-set-fresh-20260619-20260708.json (the T-W8/structure-stop-study FRESH_SIGNAL_SET, 2026-06-19..2026-07-08). Union deduplicated on (date, entry_ts, side). Older (pre-2026-05-19) signals are EXCLUDED by rule: that stratum's premarket window is IEX-sourced and/or starts at 09:00 not 04:00 (DATA-PROVENANCE.md), which would systematically undercount premarket touches relative to the SIP-covered window -- a feed-provenance confound this study will not mix.
level_history_window: 2026-05-19..2026-07-17 (matches the cached SPY 5m chain both source signal sets already validate against; tonight's structure-stop studies used the same window).
trigger_level_recovery: layer (a): tw8_level_context.enrich_signals' exact entry_spot-matched trigger-bar recovery (byte-identical method to structure_stop_study.py's prepare_layer_a). Signals with no recoverable trigger_level (level_context_status != 'ok') are EXCLUDED from the segmentation (cannot be tagged touched/untouched), counted and disclosed, never silently dropped.
premarket_touch_definition: For a signal's OWN recovered trigger_level and side, scan that date's premarket 5m bars (time < 09:30 ET, from the SAME frozen per-day LevelSet's underlying spy_full slice) and apply the PRODUCTION rejection/reclaim test verbatim (lib.filters.detect_level_rejection for side='P' triggers -- bar.high>level AND bar.close<level; detect_level_reclaim for side='C' triggers -- bar.low<level AND bar.close>level) against the singleton [trigger_level]. premarket_touch_count = number of premarket bars where that test fires. TOUCHED = premarket_touch_count >= 1; UNTOUCHED = premarket_touch_count == 0. No band/proximity parameter -- reuses the exact zero-slack test the RTH trigger detector itself uses, direction-matched to the eventual RTH trigger's side (a resistance level tests as a rejection for the eventual bear/put trigger; a support level tests as a reclaim for the eventual bull/call trigger).
replay_shape: Fixed for BOTH groups, identical to today's live behavior: SS-B (structure_stop_study.SS_B_SHAPE: -50% catastrophe cap, TP1 +100% sell66, chandelier trail 15%, runner target 9.9x) with structure_stop_signal_time(..., trigger_level, buffer=0.0) -- the trigger-exact reference, zero buffer (== BAND-00/REF-EXACT, the shape structure-stop-zone-band-2026-07-20.json and structure-stop-reference-level-2026-07-20.json both already confirmed as literal current-live behavior). No shape variation between TOUCHED and UNTOUCHED -- this isolates the premarket-touch LABEL as the only difference, not an exit-shape difference.
primary_metric: Per-trade expectancy delta (TOUCHED mean $/trade - UNTOUCHED mean $/trade), probe_stats.summarize_trades on each group.
significance_tests: RANDOM-LABEL PERMUTATION NULL: shuffle the TOUCHED/UNTOUCHED labels across the eligible population B=2000 times (group sizes held fixed), recompute the mean-expectancy delta each shuffle, empirical two-sided p_random = fraction(|null_delta| >= |observed_delta|).

SHUFFLED-LEVEL NULL: for each eligible signal, replace its OWN trigger_level with a RANDOMLY CHOSEN OTHER active level from that same day's frozen LevelSet.active (excluding the real trigger_level; skip signals with no alternate level that day), recompute premarket_touch_count/labels using the SAME production test, re-derive the segmentation delta. Repeat M=500 independent re-draws, empirical two-sided p_shuffled_level = fraction(|null_delta| >= |observed_delta|). This tests whether the effect is LEVEL-SPECIFIC (real trigger_level's own premarket history) vs merely DAY-GENERAL (days with more premarket chop look different regardless of which level is checked).
bh_fdr: backtest.futures.battery.bh_fdr (Benjamini-Hochberg step-up, alpha=0.05) applied across the 2 p-values above (p_random, p_shuffled_level) plus, if n permits (>=8 per direction per group), the same 2 tests repeated on the bear-only and bull-only sub-populations (up to 6 p-values total) -- reused verbatim, no new FDR implementation.
concentration_disclosure: probe_stats.day_concentration + concentration_flag (top3-day % of net) on the TOUCHED group's per-day PnL. A nominal effect driven >50% by 3 days is disclosed as CONCENTRATED regardless of p-value (C4/C24).
sub_window_stability: Population split at the midpoint date (by unique trading day, ~50/50). A nominal PASS with a first-half/second-half sign flip on the segmentation delta is downgraded to NO_SHIP_SUBWINDOW_UNSTABLE, matching tonight's structure-stop studies' convention exactly.
small_n_floor: probe_stats.significance / SMALL_N_NOTE_THRESHOLD-style disclosure: n_touched < 8 or n_untouched < 8 is flagged INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERPOWERED regardless of nominal p-values -- this population (n~40 total, touched likely a minority) is disclosed in advance as LIKELY underpowered; that is an honest expected outcome, not a study defect.
verdict_ladder: SIGNAL (worth a follow-up layer-b real-fills confirmatory study + eventual wire) requires ALL of: both p_random and p_shuffled_level BH-FDR-survive at alpha=0.05, no sub-window sign flip, TOUCHED group not CONCENTRATED, n_touched>=8. Otherwise KILL (a valid outcome per the item's own framing) or INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERPOWERED if only the n-floor fails while directional signs still agree.
no_wire_this_run: This run NEVER touches heartbeat_core.py/level_states/params.json/any trading-path file regardless of verdict -- the queue item's own scope is 'NOT a same-day wire'. A SIGNAL verdict is filed back to queue.md as a new, separately-scoped wiring item for a future fire, per the item's own closing sentence.
frictionless_fills_disclosure: Frictionless fills at trigger/stop/target levels (no spread/queue modelled), matching every prior study in this codebase built on structure_stop_study.py's replay engine.
c6_lookahead_note: premarket_touch_count for a signal is computed ONLY from bars strictly before 09:30 ET on that signal's OWN date, using the SAME frozen LevelSet (computed at that date's first bar >=09:35 ET, i.e., AFTER the premarket window closes but the level VALUES themselves -- PMH/PML, PDH/PDL, 5-day H/L, round numbers -- are either static multi-day references fixed before today opened, or today's PMH/PML which by construction only reflect bars <=09:30, so no bar after the signal's own entry_ts is ever read for either the level VALUES or the touch COUNT).

closed_2026_09_02.verdict: KILL. n_touched=15 vs n_untouched=12, delta $286.62, p_random=0.21, p_shuffled_level=0.208 -- BH-FDR survivors [False, False], neither significant. The premarket-touch credit does not survive its own nulls.
closed_2026_09_02.note: Population is small by construction (41 signals, 27 eligible after 14 excluded for no recoverable trigger_level). The verdict is a clean null, not an underpowered shrug -- both null comparisons were run and both failed.
